positive_defence_result: Primary-ledger snapshot rollback rejected while spent-nonce registry remains current
negative_controls: Retained v3.4 local-only snapshot rollback test shows replay is possible when its only ledger is rolled back.
Coordinated rollback of both primary and registry databases permits replay; this documents the need for a separately protected registry.
limitations: Registry service and primary verifier run on the same test host in this reference test.
No production non-rollbackable store is provisioned.
No upstream Lycheetah source files were changed.
